label: Trojan Horse (Greek & American, carry-out tri-fold)
note: Two landscape tri-fold panels, sepia print, small type — the whole spread in one 1600px image, which is close to what the app uploads (long edge capped at 1568px), so legibility here is a real-world finding, not a test artifact. Traps: photo captions that repeat dish names ('Pita Melt', 'Gyros', 'Pitas & Cream', 'Courthouse Fish', 'Greek Sampler', 'Combination Plate 1') must not create duplicates or new dishes; nested headings A LITTLE SOMETHING BEFORE → Greek / American; burger size lines, 'Dressed your way' topping grid, Dressings and Extras lists are not dishes. source.kind: restaurant website PDF, rendered to JPEG at 1600px

dishes.name: Better Burgers
dishes.description: Yep, we're pretty proud of 'em. Order them as you like. We'll cook'em up for ya.

dishes.name: Vegan Burger
dishes.description: Our own recipe with just the right mix of black beans, red onion, red peppers, chipotle pepper in adobo sauce, and our secret blend of spices! Served on Vegan flatbread. Dressed your way.

dishes.name: Fish Sandwich
dishes.description: Tilapia, breaded and served on a bun with our own tartar sauce, lettuce and tomato.

dishes.name: Pita Melt
dishes.description: Trojan’s twist on the classic patty melt. We start with the perfect burger patty, top it with a slice of melted American cheese and sautéed onions – seasoned just right. Then we serve it up on bun-sized grilled pitas.

dishes.name: Popeye & Olive Oil
dishes.description: You’re gonna love this very grown-up and unique twist on grilled cheese. Wilted baby spinach sautéed with fresh garlic and olive oil grilled on thick sliced homemade bread with brie and apricot preserves. A classic... just like Popeye!

dishes.name: All-American Chicken
dishes.description: A tender charbroiled chicken breast, seasoned to perfection and served with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise on a bun. As American as hot dogs or apple pie!

dishes.name: Btown BBQ
dishes.description: These mouth watering mini sandwiches are made from the best cuts of pork, rubbed, slow-cooked and sauced up just right! Served on a fresh, yellow egg bun.

dishes.name: Tenderloin - Breaded or Grilled
dishes.description: Handmade breaded pork loin, deep fried and served on a bun or fresh-cut tenderloin, lightly seasoned and grilled to perfection. Dressed your way.

dishes.name: Grilled Portabella Wrap
dishes.description: Fresh portabella mushrooms sautéed with our Chimichurri sauce. Wrapped in pita bread with romaine lettuce, grated parmesan cheese, and red onions. Caesar dressing on the side.

dishes.name: Falafel Taco
dishes.description: A new twist on one of your veggie favorites! A spicy blend of chick peas and bulghur wheat deep fried and wrapped in a flour tortilla. Topped with red cabbage and our own pico de gallo.

dishes.name: Pork Taco
dishes.description: Slow-cooked pork seasoned with a hint of hot in a soft flour tortilla. Topped with grated cheese, lettuce and a side of our salsa verde.

dishes.name: Fish Taco
dishes.description: One flour tortillas filled with spicy breaded Tilapia, red cabbage, pico de gallo and a side of our “cool” hot sauce.

dishes.name: Gyros
dishes.description: A delicious blend of savory lamb, beef and spices. Our unique method of cooking seals the juices and seasonings into the gyros meat, which we make ourselves. The gyros is sliced very thin and topped off with tomatoes, onions and our own Zaziki sauce (a combination of yogurt, sour cream, cucumbers and garlic).

dishes.name: Super G
dishes.description: Our gyros with more meat, more veggies, and more Zaziki but not more pita.

dishes.name: Falafel
dishes.description: A spicy blend of chick peas and bulghur wheat. Deep fried, wrapped in pita with lettuce, tomato, onion and Tahini sauce.

dishes.name: The V.I.P.
dishes.description: Sautéed mushrooms, green peppers and onions, topped with fresh tomatoes, sprouts, onions and lettuce on pita with Zaziki.

dishes.name: Souvlaki
dishes.description: Marinated pork loin skewer broiled and served on pita with Zaziki, fresh sliced onions and tomatoes.

dishes.name: Chicken Gyros
dishes.description: A lighter version of our old standby! Tender strips of chicken breast seasoned just like our gyros sandwich. Wrapped in a pita and topped with fresh onions, tomatoes and Zaziki sauce.

dishes.name: Super Chicken
dishes.description: Our chicken gyros with more of everything but not more pita.

dishes.name: Baklava
dishes.description: The best known of the Greek pastries— many layers of thin filo with lots of honey, cinnamon and finely crushed walnuts.

expected.note: its still a ton of sugar...

dishes.name: Baklava Ice Cream
dishes.description: Our own Baklava folded into vanilla ice cream.

dishes.name: Ambrosia
dishes.description: Truly the nectar of the Gods. Delicious yogurt, walnuts and honey.

dishes.name: Pitas & Cream
dishes.description: A scoop of our Baklava ice cream garnished with cinnamon pita points.

dishes.name: Cheesecake
dishes.description: Ask your server for today’s flavor.

dishes.name: Double Chocolate Brownie
dishes.description: Made fresh daily with lots of chocolate, blood orange infused olive oil, and dairy-free ingredients. Loads of flavor!

dishes.name: Root Beer Float
dishes.description: Gourmet Sprecher Root Beer and vanilla ice cream.

dishes.name: Tabouleh
dishes.description: Traditional Mediterranean salad with bulghur wheat, tomatoes, onions, cucumbers, parsley and spices.

dishes.name: Black Bean Hummus
dishes.description: Uh huh! Made with black beans instead of chick peas, all spiced up hummus-like! Served with two pitas.

dishes.name: Stuffed Grape Leaves
dishes.description: (Dolmas) Stuffed with rice, almonds and currants. Three per order. Served warm.

dishes.name: Spanakopita
dishes.description: (Spinach Pie) A filo pastry filled with spinach and cheese. Better order more than one!

dishes.name: Cheesepa’rer
dishes.description: Spinach and feta cheese spread served with two quartered pitas – think of it as hummus for cheese-heads.

dishes.name: Meatballs Kokkinisto
dishes.description: A blend of beef and lamb seasoned just right with Parmesan and Fontinella cheeses baked right in. Topped with a hearty Greek red sauce.

dishes.name: Hummus
dishes.description: Chick peas and tahini, blended and spiced up just right... scoop it up with two quartered pitas.

dishes.name: Greek Sampler
dishes.description: Hummus, Cheesepa’rer, Black Bean Hummus and Tabouleh served with two quartered pitas. A great beginning!

dishes.name: Fries
dishes.description: Handcut daily with Walter’s slicer.

dishes.name: Super Fries
dishes.description: A whole basket full of ‘em.

dishes.name: Jalapeño Straws
dishes.description: Fresh cut jalapeños breaded in our beer batter. Served with a side of jalapeño mayo. Olé!

dishes.name: Breaded Mushrooms
dishes.description: Only the best will do – all dipped in our beer batter.

dishes.name: Breaded Onion Rings
dishes.description: Fresh onion rings dipped in beer batter.

dishes.name: Breaded Green Peppers
dishes.description: A very fresh, dipped and battered veggie.

dishes.name: Breaded Dill Pickles
dishes.description: That’s right. Breaded pickle spears!

dishes.name: Mixed Veggies
dishes.description: Mushrooms, green peppers, jalapeño straws and onions all dipped in batter, fried and delicious.

dishes.name: Mediterranean Antipasto Salad
dishes.description: Made with garbanzo beans, quinoa, red and green peppers, red onion, cilantro, Kalamata olives, feta cheese, almonds and our herbed oil and vinegar dressing.

dishes.name: Greek Salad
dishes.description: A classic. A mix of iceberg and romaine lettuce garnished with tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, feta cheese and Greek olives. Traditionally served with herbed oil & vinegar.

dishes.name: Dolmasalata
dishes.description: Tomatoes, cucumbers, onions, feta cheese and olives topped with olive oil, vinegar and spices.

dishes.name: Garden Salad
dishes.description: Lettuce, tomatoes, sliced carrots and red cabbage. Enough said.

dishes.name: Portabella Spinach Salad
dishes.description: Portabellas grilled with chimichurri sauce, feta cheese, red onions and bacon make this fresh spinach salad a real contender. Add a drizzle of balsamic vinegar. Ooh La La!

dishes.name: Chicken Pasta Salad
dishes.description: Three flavors of spiral pasta tossed with spinach, onions, tomatoes, Greek olives and feta cheese. Topped with strips of charbroiled chicken breast and served with your choice of dressing.

dishes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
dishes.description: Grilled chicken breast atop a bed of fresh romaine lettuce with hard-boiled eggs, bacon, red onions, and grated parmesan. This is a serious salad. Served with pita croutons and Caesar dressing.

dishes.name: Soup of the day
dishes.description: Oh so good & sooo good for you!

dishes.name: Gyros Dinner
dishes.description: A heaping portion of our gyros meat on a bed of rice with pita bread, tomatoes, onions and side of Zaziki. Served with a Greek salad.

dishes.name: Moussaka Dinner
dishes.description: Traditional Greek casserole with eggplant, meat sauce and custard topping. Served with a Greek salad and Tabouleh.

dishes.name: Combination Plate I
dishes.description: A healthy portion of the three Greek meat dishes served at the Trojan Horse. Moussaka, Gyros and Souvlaki plus a Dolmasalata, Tabouleh and Spanakopita.

dishes.name: Combination Plate II
dishes.description: These five unique Greek offerings make one great meal. Stuffed Grape Leaves, Spanakopita, Tabouleh, Falafel, and Hummus served with pita bread and a Dolmasalata. A vegetarian delight!

dishes.name: Courthouse Fish
dishes.description: Tilapia seasoned with olive oil, white wine and herbs, steamed in foil served atop a bed of sautéed rice and veggies.

dishes.name: Pasko’s Skewer
dishes.description: A savory, marinated steak kabob with fresh vegetables on a bed of rice with our own Chimichurri sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Chicken Giannoulas
dishes.description: Our melt-in-your-mouth boneless chicken breast, carefully marinated and open grilled, served on sautéed rice with vegetables. Big enough for dinner, but great for lunch.

dishes.name: Lamb Kabob
dishes.description: A modern twist to a classic Greek dish. Deliciously marinated lamb skewered with red onions, red peppers and mushrooms on a bed of rice.

dishes.name: Bottled Root Beer
dishes.description: Gourmet Root Beer from the award-winning Sprecher Breweryin Milwaukee.
